items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: That was with a lot of Duke Ellington's men. I had a picture -- there was quite a few fellas on there Harry Edison reads personnel -- Tiny Grimes and Billy Bauer on guitar.

ctx.x: You were talking about the Down beat poll -- how did they usually categorize you?

Miscellaneous instrument. I wasn't compared to the great guys -- although I was playin' with 'em, you know. So somehow or other I think I made second in Down beat, and I won the Metronome. That was with a lot of Duke Ellington's men. I had a picture -- there was quite a few fellas on there
